I had the opportunity to visit IT Square Laksi and found it to be a charming mall in its own way. While not a brand-new, luxury mall, it's very comprehensive and practical.

Inside, there's a wide variety of restaurants, shops, banks, IT stores, mobile phone stores, and various services. It was easy to come for errands but ended up browsing leisurely afterwards.

What I liked most was the relaxed atmosphere; it wasn't overly crowded, making it easy to navigate and not as chaotic as many larger malls. It's perfect for shopping, grabbing a bite to eat, or running errands on a weekday.

Another convenient feature is the wide selection of computer, IT equipment, and mobile phone stores. Anyone looking for tech gadgets or general-purpose equipment can find plenty to choose from.

Overall, it's a mall that has been a fixture in the Laksi area for a long time, offering a complete yet simple, comfortable, and convenient shopping experience. It's a place that locals frequent regularly. ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
